build_get_model_options: build a function call to get_model_options for a provider and mode returning a list of model tuples
create_get_known_models: create a function call to get_known_models that returns a dict of provider to sorted model name lists
run_get_model_options_openai: run get_model_options with provider 'openai' and mode 'quick' to retrieve available OpenAI model choices
summarize_get_known_models: summarize the output of get_known_models for all supported LLM providers and their available model names
test_get_model_options_anthropic: test get_model_options with provider 'anthropic' and mode 'deep' to verify returned model tuples
